summary: Oncolytics Biotech Inc. filed a Form 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing initial preclinical data for pelareorep in combination with RAS inhibitor modalities. The press release details early results from a solid tumor model showing greater anti-tumor activity in combination. Plans include additional studies in pancreatic and colorectal cancer models. This is a routine research and development update, not a special situation. No deal terms, M&A activity, or corporate restructuring is involved. The filing is purely informational regarding preclinical progress.
